title: Pricing Desk Note — Variable and Capped Variable Rates on Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Rate of a month-to-month agreement.** A month-to-month Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement is billed at its contract rate for its first introductory cycles (the plan's initial cycles billed at the enrollment rate) and for any cycles held at the expiring rate under the gas rollover rules.

**After that.** After those cycles, and on a capped variable plan from the first cycle, each cycle is billed at the new rate of the latest variable rate change notice on the agreement whose effective date is on or before the cycle's billing period start date; until the first such notice applies, the contract rate continues.

**Effective basis.** A variable rate change takes effect only for billing cycles beginning on or after its effective date.

**Notice period.** A variable rate change notice must be issued at least the plan's variable rate notice period (10 calendar days on every plan) before its stated effective date; when it is issued later, the change applies only from the first cycle beginning on or after the notice date plus 10 calendar days.

**Ceiling.** On a plan whose rate ceiling applies, the rate billed in a cycle is the lower of that variable rate and the contract rate.

**Fixed plans.** Variable rate changes never apply to a fixed plan during its term.

### Late notice worked through (hypothetical dates)

A notice dated 25 March states an effective date of 1 April — 7 days' notice, fewer than 10. The change applies only from the first cycle beginning on or after 4 April (25 March plus 10 days). A cycle beginning 1 April is billed at the previous rate; a cycle beginning 1 May is billed at the new rate.

### Ceiling worked through (hypothetical rates)

On Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12, whose rate ceiling applies, with a contract rate of 0.7950 per therm:

| Variable rate in force for the cycle | Rate billed |
|---|---|
| 0.8400 | 0.7950 (the contract rate is lower) |
| 0.7600 | 0.7600 (the variable rate is lower) |
| 0.7950 | 0.7950 |
